name: Cue: Voice-Paced Prompter
subtitle: Script reader & video recorder
promotionalText: No subscription, no watermark. Voice Pace scrolls while you talk and stops when you pause, so you never chase the words.
description:
Cue is a teleprompter that keeps up with you instead of racing ahead.

Write or paste your script, tap Prompt and read. Turn on Voice Pace and the words move only while you're talking, then wait when you stop. No more chasing the text or scrolling back.

READ NATURALLY
• Voice Pace: the words move while you talk and wait when you pause. It listens to the sound level only, on your phone.
• Steady scroll with speed nudges, a countdown and a timer.
• Big, clear text with a reading line. Pinch to resize, drag to scroll back, tap to pause.
• Mirror and flip for beam-splitter rigs. Landscape works too.

RECORD AT THE LENS
• Record with your script right under the camera, so your eyes stay near the lens.
• Every take goes straight to Photos. No watermark, ever.
• Record one section at a time and retake just the bit you fluffed.

WRITE FASTER
• Sections you can jump to, pause cues and private notes that are never read out.
• Fit any script to 30 seconds, a minute, 90 seconds or longer: Cue sets the pace for you.
• See the read time and words per minute as you write, with a live preview of the prompter.
• Import .txt and Markdown files. Search, pin, duplicate and share your scripts.

FREE, THEN ONE SMALL PAYMENT IF YOU WANT MORE
The teleprompter, steady scroll, recording and unlimited scripts are free. Every Plus feature is free for your first 7 days, with nothing charged automatically. After that, Cue Plus is a single payment, not a subscription: Voice Pace and Voice Follow, caption files (.srt and .vtt timed to your pace), prompter colours, Word import and rehearsal stats.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your scripts and videos stay on your phone.

reviewNotes:
No account or login. Cue is a teleprompter: open a script (a Welcome script is included) and tap Prompt to scroll it, or Record to film with the script over the camera; takes are saved to Photos with no watermark. Voice Pace (the mic chip on the prompter) measures the microphone sound level on the device so the text moves while the user talks; nothing is recognised, recorded or uploaded. The camera is used only on the Record screen and Photos access is add-only. In-app purchase: 'Cue Plus' (non-consumable, one-time) on Settings > Cue Plus, with Restore purchase on the same screen; every Plus feature is free for the first 7 days after first launch (no auto-charge), then locks unless bought. No data is collected.

App Review information:
1. Screen recording: supplied with the reply (physical iPhone, latest iOS).
2. Purpose and audience: a teleprompter for creators, presenters, teachers and anyone filming themselves or giving a talk. It shows the script at eye level and, with Voice Pace, moves the text only while the user is speaking, so they never lose their place or read too fast.
3. Setup: no login or sample files needed; a Welcome script is included. Prompt scrolls the script; Record films with the script over the camera; the mic chip turns on Voice Pace.
4. External services: none for core functionality. Only Apple In-App Purchase (StoreKit). No server, accounts, analytics, ads or AI; speech is not recognised or uploaded.
5. Regional differences: none; works the same in all regions (only the purchase price is localised).
6. Regulated industry / third-party material: not applicable.
